description: Apply a surgical, field-level patch to a draft using explicit set / append / unset operations by dotted path (e.g. set "grader.rel_tol", append "verification.evidence"), not a full rewrite, so the change stays legible. Returns the updated record, an itemized list of what changed, and a re-run of the self-consistency check since the grader may have moved. Draft-only — submitted records are frozen.

append.description: Dotted-path → items appended to an array field, e.g. {"discrimination.positive": ["0.357"]}.

draft_id.description: The draft record id to patch.

set.description: Dotted-path → value replacements, e.g. {"grader.rel_tol": 0.001}. Cannot target task_type or server-owned fields.

unset.description: Dotted paths to remove from the record, e.g. ["metadata.contamination_notes"].

name: evals_revise_draft

changed.description: The itemized changes applied, in order — the legibility record.

items.description: One applied patch operation with its before/after values.

after.description: The value after the change (absent for unset).

before.description: The value before the change (absent for created paths).

path.description: The dotted path that was changed.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No record exists with the given draft id. `record_frozen`: The target id refers to a submitted (frozen) record. `invalid_patch_path`: A set/unset path does not resolve, an append targets a non-array, or a protected field (task_type, id, checksum) was targeted. `task_type_constraint`: The patch left the record violating a per-task-type rule (mcq without choices; free_response without llm_rubric grader). `mcq_choice_mismatch`: After the patch, the mcq grader correct answer is not one of the choices. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

record.description: The updated draft record after the patch.

server_checks.description: The re-run self-consistency result after the patch.

gold_passes_grader.description: True when the gold passes its own grader.

grader_ok.description: True when gold + all positives pass and all negatives (≥1) are rejected.

negatives_rejected.description: Per-negative rejection verdict (true = correctly rejected), in declaration order.

positives_pass.description: Per-positive pass verdict, in declaration order.

ready_to_submit.description: True only when both grader_ok and verification_present are true.

verification_present.description: True when at least one verification.evidence entry exists.

title: evals-mcp-server: revise draft
